gloss: uncollected receivable; outstanding amount owed to one

definitions.gloss: uncollected receivable; money still owed to one; accounts receivable
definitions.explanation: Money that has been earned or billed but not yet received. In everyday use it is an amount a customer still owes; in accounting it is an asset recorded for revenue already recognized.

examples.japanese: {未収金|みしゅうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{未収金|みしゅうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}した→回収する：21142_kaishuusuru⟧。
examples.english: We finally collected last month's outstanding receivables.

examples.japanese: ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{倒産|とうさん}→倒産：03452_tousan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{多額|たがく}→多額：12309_tagaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{未収金|みしゅうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}って→残る：01187_nokoru⟧しまった。
examples.english: A client's bankruptcy left us with a large amount of uncollected receivables.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経理|けいり}→経理：06439_keiri⟧⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{月末|げつまつ}→月末：00070_getsumatsu⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{未収金|みしゅうきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一覧表|いちらんひょう}→一覧表：22737_ichiranhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: The accounting staff prepares a list of outstanding receivables at the end of each month.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧ (not yet) plus {収|しゅう} (to collect, to take in) plus {金|きん} (money). It is standard vocabulary in accounting and billing; in casual speech people say ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{払|はら}って→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦もらっていない→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧ instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未収金|みしゅうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: for a receivable to remain outstanding
- {未収金|みしゅうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}する→回収する：21142_kaishuusuru⟧: to collect an amount owed
- {未収金|みしゅうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計上|けいじょう}→計上：08006_keijou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to record a receivable on the books

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{未払|みはら}い{金|きん}→未払い金：30179_miharaikin⟧: unpaid amount — money you owe, the mirror image of {未収金|みしゅうきん}
- ⟦{売掛金|うりかけきん}→売掛金：30203_urikakekin⟧: accounts receivable — narrower; only credit sales of goods or services
- ⟦{滞納|たいのう}→滞納：09323_tainou⟧: delinquency, arrears — stresses that a payment is overdue
